summary: A first-time candidate makes a personal call to someone who might help fund the race.
realLife: owner, Nov 8: A first campaign includes the work of talking to potential donors.
inGame: The donor-ask situation supplies the request; first-campaign wording requires candidacy history.

turns.what: The prospective donor asks to see the filing before discussing a contribution.
turns.pulledBy: The candidate has announced and the paperwork is still being processed.
turns.writesBack: The call produces a request for information and no pledge.

turns.what: The former coworker cannot afford a donation and offers the use of a kitchen for a gathering.
turns.pulledBy: The candidate knows the caller personally and the caller has offered space without promising money.
turns.writesBack: The campaign records a possible host and leaves the cash tally alone.
